introduction.p: For any function f: \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N} and any set A \subseteq \mathbb{N}\text{,} we can define the image of A under f to be the set of all outputs of f when the input is an element of A\text{.} We write this as f(A) = \{f(x) ~:~ x \in A\}\text{.}
For the following tasks, lets explore the function f: \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N} defined by f(x) = x^2 - 3x + 8\text{.}

statement.p: Let A = \{1,2,3\} and B = \{2, 4, 6\}\text{.} Find f(A) and f(B)\text{.} Then find f(A) \cup f(B)\text{.}
Now find A \cup B and f(A \cup B)\text{.}
Give an example, if one exists, of two distinct sets A and B such that A \subseteq B and f(A) \subseteq f(B)\text{.}
Give an example, if one exists, of two distinct sets A and B such that A \subseteq B but f(A) \not\subseteq f(B)\text{.}
